content.evidence_note: Actual worked literature method read in original PDF Sections 4–8. This recipe is not a separate established theorem or complete Hard Family record. Appendix primitive and spectral-design proofs are imported interfaces; no new local transfer theorem is asserted.
failure_modes: Showing the numerical product NM alone supplies no lower bound.
Early full rotation disclosure destroys the intended information barrier; all-block matrix products are a different permission.
Gating full quadratic curvature can violate the Hessian Lipschitz budget.
Flat gates alone permit unwanted partial-gate stationary points without the positive-forcing argument.
A matrix-vector simulator may fail to produce exposed gate-gradient vectors unless retirement disclosure is included.
A fixed-dimension, stronger-oracle or noisy-oracle extension does not follow automatically.
content.goal_pattern: Establish a product N times M rather than merely max(N,M) in an unrestricted exact first-order lower bound.
content.key_choice: Keep all quadratic terms permanently present. Reveal fresh (u_s,b_s) at deterministic tau_s=1+(s-1)m; reveal the entire U_s only at sigma_s=1+sm. Do not identify matrix-vector access with advance knowledge of the rotation. In the auxiliary oracle, omit a block's outgoing coupling until retirement; after retirement the disclosed U_s,u_s determine its physical readout, so gate gradients are computable without undisclosed a_s.
content.key_relation: With h=H epsilon, gamma=c_gamma sqrt(L2 h), D=h²/gamma, N=floor(c_N Delta/D), M=floor(c_M sqrt(L1/gamma)), m=floor(M/2), N M is of order Delta sqrt(L1) L2^(1/4) epsilon^(-7/4). Before retirement |v_s(z_s,t)|<=1/4; epsilon-stationarity requires all first N-1 gates open and final-system residual <=epsilon.
proof_skeleton: Section 5 defines F(z)=sum_s z_s^T A_s z_s/2-ell_1(z_1)-sum_{s=2}^N chi(v_{s-1}(z_{s-1}))ell_s(z_s), with v_s=a_s^T R_B(z_s)/alpha0, q_s=b_s^T z_s/D, ell_s=D(C0+vartheta(q_s)), alpha0=c_alpha h/gamma and B=C_B h/gamma. Import the stated primitive and spectral-design interfaces rather than assuming a generic direct sum suffices.

Sections 6.1–6.2 establish global smoothness/gap for every realization and, on the weight event, complete activation for every near-stationary point. Positivity prevents cancellation at partially open gates; two scalar projections first force saturation into its linear region.

Definition 7.1 publicly supplies spectrum/partition and returns (A_s z_s,t,U_s^T z_s,t) for every block, plus censored (F_t,gradient F_t). Disclosures precede query choice. Included couplings have a retired predecessor and disclosed successor RHS; no undisclosed readout vector is required.

Lemma 7.1, before sigma_s, bounds latent queries by span{Lambda^j g_s,i: i<=t,0<=j<=t-i} plus, after tau_s, span{Lambda^j u_s:0<=j<=t-tau_s}. Gaussian starts are independent of u_s, also conditional on other blocks' raw draws. Independence across blocks' constructed Gaussian families is not asserted.

Lemma 7.2 uses V=cyc_Lambda(span of T0 Gaussian starts), K_m=span{u,...,Lambda^(m-1)u} and readout a_tilde=r(Lambda)u/||r(Lambda)u||. With policy-independent multiplicities, |a_tilde^T w|<=C(delta+eta)||w|| for w in K_m+V. Sufficient multiplicities obey K_j>=C[T0²+eta^(-2)T0+delta^(-2)]log(2JN/zeta) and |K_j/d0-nu_j|<=(delta/4)nu_j. Choose 2BC(delta+eta)<=alpha0/4.

Corollary 7.1 applies radial direction preservation and ||R_B||<=2B to keep gates flat before retirement even for unbounded queries. Lemma 7.3 inductively equates true and censored transcripts through T0 because each omitted gate and its first derivative vanish.

Lemma 7.4 and Proposition 8.1 turn the activation/final-residual requirement into Omega(Nm)=Omega(NM) calls. Append arbitrary terminal output as one final query. Fix the distribution before the policy/seed; average deterministic seedwise bounds for the randomized conclusion.
content.required_inputs: Independent SPD quadratic blocks A_s=U_s Lambda U_s^T with high spectral multiplicities; independent uniform latent u_s and b_s=h U_s u_s; fixed residual r=lambda^(-1)-p_star from the finite weighted spectral design; a_s=r(A_s)b_s/||r(A_s)b_s||; bounded positive forcing, a smooth flat gate, and a radial direction-preserving bounded map. The source supplies the exceptional zero-denominator convention and requisite moment events in Section 5.
transfer_obligations: Reestablish the finite spectral residual, short-Krylov orthogonality and high-multiplicity projection bound under the proposed oracle.
Prove conditional-rotation invariance with actual cross-block feedback; conditioning on raw independent draws is distinct from conditioning on adaptive transcripts.
Specify all public/hidden information and prove that the auxiliary censored feedback is computable. No future RHS or full rotation may leak during its hiding interval.
Prove true/censored transcript equality on a sufficiently probable event; the censored oracle is not an unconditional replacement for the true oracle.
Verify global derivative/gap budgets for every sampled function, rule out partial-gate stationary points, and handle arbitrary unqueried outputs.
Choose finite dimensions/multiplicities independently of the policy, and justify the intended cap and success quantifiers.
